title: B2-24 · Review, simulation and profile for skill

blocks.text: B2-24 · Review, simulation and profile for skill
Lesson overview

The last four weeks of the level serve to consolidate, measure and decide where to work. There's no new grammar. In the first week you review the vocabulary for areas and the grammatical and textual framework of B2 and reread the units; in the second, do a complete simulation of the exam , with new texts and in real conditions; in the third build your profile for skill and start working on gaps; in the fourth complete recovery and review. In the week 253 support the exam B2 (Part IV). The MAG track-04 continues in its separate blocks and closes in the week 252.

rows: Module testing B2.1 → B2.4 exceeded; INT-A and INT-B exercises (B2-23) held
20–22 hours · four weeks (weeks 249–252 of the calendar), plus the exam in the week 253; MAG-04 continues in its separate blocks

blocks.text: Materials All volume, Appendix B (lexic), Reference Grammar (Part VI), Error Notebook, Advance Record, Authentic Articles and Newspapers (Appendix C), a native language tutor for oral simulation and an Egyptian speaker
Targets. At the end of the four weeks:
1. recognize and use vocabulary B2 of the twenty-one areas of the section 2;
2. recognize without hesitation the framework structures of the section 3 and the variety of a dialect phrase;
3. read in silence an authentic article without vowels of about 400 words at least 90 words per minute and
distinguish facts, sources, opinions and degree of certainty;
4. understand an interview and a debate in fuṣḥā spoken, an Egyptian song without subtitles and write a dictation
with at least the 90% correct words;
5. translate an article of about 200 words (Accessories at least 3/4) and in Arabic a simple news
of about 70 words;
6. write an argumentative text of about 300 words and a neutral synthesis of about 150 words;
7. expose for five minutes a topic in fuṣḥā Talk, discuss, report a news and converse in Egyptian;
8. know your skill profile and you know which units to review before the exam.
Four-week plan.

14. Ready for the exam?
Each entry will be checked before the week 253.
1. I passed the four module tests (or repeated them with the tutor) and did INT-A and INT-B.
2. In the simulation I have at least 12/20 in each section, or I did the recovery indicated by the profile.
3. I read in silence an authentic article without vowels at least 90 words per minute.
4. My dictation has at least the 90% of correct words.
5. In the translation to Italian I have at least 3/4 of Accuracy and I make attribution and degree of certainty.
6. In the translation to Arabic I avoid the casts of the table of B2-15.
7. I can write a complete argumentative text in 50 minutes and a neutral synthesis in 40.
8. I have at least eight topics-cards ready for the exhibition and discussion.
9. In Egyptian I know how to tell, comment on news and express a reservation in read register.
10. I've set up the tutor for the three half-days of the exam, and I'm ready who will read the scripts (even the voice)
